outcome: Add and verify the repository task-completion workflow without changing application behaviour.
boundary: This is local evidence accounting, not authenticated review, release approval or automatic orchestration.
Status performs no checks/mutations, only read-only inventory; run executes one explicitly selected argv with owned cleanup and no saved logs/environment.
Full verification requires current fast checks and boundary review. Final completion also requires current implementation review.
Receipts bind declared worktree inputs, including untracked files; changed source or review artifacts become stale.
Preserve existing work. No application changes, provisioning, deployment, dependency additions or automatic agents.
outOfScope: Claiming general model efficiency gains from one pilot
